site.subtitle: A collection of some of my favorite builds.

kumiko-style-lamp.title: Kumiko Style Lamp
kumiko-style-lamp.desc: Walnut and Purpleheart Beams, with Maple base. UV laser engraved and cut glass topper, CNC engraved diffuser.

cutting-board.title: Cutting Board
cutting-board.desc: Maple, Walnut, Purpleheart, Padauk, with Brass + Rubber Feet.

charleston-union-pier-map.title: Charleston Union Pier Map
charleston-union-pier-map.desc: Maple + Walnut, Epoxy fill street map and brass Union Pier inlay, glass front.

balance-scale.title: Balance Scale
balance-scale.desc: Maple, Walnut, Oak, with Intentionality tokens.

rotating-poster-frame.title: Rotating Poster Frame
rotating-poster-frame.desc: Battery operated oak frame containing 10 posters on a motorized scroll with backlighting, controllable by bluetooth app.

anamorphic-crystal-engraving.title: Anamorphic Crystal Engraving
anamorphic-crystal-engraving.desc: Uses custom program to take 3D file, break into pieces, scale for depth and refractive index, and align to focal point.

walnut-maple-lamp.title: Walnut Maple Lamp
walnut-maple-lamp.desc: Hollow octagonal Walnut pole with custom internal wiring and brass topper on maple base.

steel-paper-towel-roll-holder.title: Steel Paper Towel Roll Holder
steel-paper-towel-roll-holder.desc: 9lb solid welded steel with brass topper.

habit-tracker.title: Habit Tracker
habit-tracker.desc: Walnut, brass + epoxy inlays, and glass shelf.

pierscope1.title: Union Pier Research App
pierscope1.desc:
A field research app designed for analyzing Charleston neighborhoods in relation to Union Pier.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/pierscope/id6774477136

pierscope-companion-viewer.title: Union Pier Research Web Viewer
pierscope-companion-viewer.desc: Website for viewing data collected from PierScope app.

inkpress1.title: PixelPrint
inkpress1.desc: Takes input image and breaks it into color layers, and creates halftone or solid laser files for creating linoleum print plates.

marble-track-generator.title: Marble Track Generator
marble-track-generator.desc: Generates 3d printable marble track based on base plate shape, designed for use with robotic arm to reset marbles.

kumiko-generator.title: Kumiko Woodworking Pattern Generator
kumiko-generator.desc: Generates custom Kumiko patters based on parameters for woodworking project.

orbitframe1.title: Orbit Frame App
orbitframe1.desc: Bluetooth control app for the motorized poster frame above. Thanks for the help James.

img-0367.title: Weather Display
img-0367.desc: 480x480 TFT in 3D printed housing, custom WiFi program.

ros.title: 4 Axis + Gripper Robotic Arm Operating System
ros.desc: Designed for the BCN3D Moveo Arm, offers keyboard control and macro recording.

crystal-anamorphic-sculptor.title: Crystal anamorphic sculptor
crystal-anamorphic-sculptor.desc: Takes 3D model, places it in crystal cube with simulated refractive index, breaks the model into pieces and disperses + scales them to create an anamorphic engraving only viewable from one angle.

linegen.title: LineGen
linegen.desc: Procedural Line Art Generator for Ink Press Printing, creates design from parameters and makes print plate files for laser engraver.

vision-board.title: Vision Board App
vision-board.desc: Solves issues with Apple Freeform to create an app that is easier to navigate with a keyboard and mouse.

512b88f9-5bc6-46e9-981a-e9307496cc6e-1-1.title: Woodblock Print + Frame
512b88f9-5bc6-46e9-981a-e9307496cc6e-1-1.desc: Walnut + Maple Frame, Woodblock Print on Linen

frame.title: Coaxial Arm
frame.desc: For future sand magnet ball table.
